questions.skill: Prove that linear functions grow by equal differences and exponential functions grow by equal factors over equal intervals
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: f(x) = 3x + 5. Show that f grows by equal differences over equal intervals: find f(x + h) - f(x) in simplest form, and explain why it does not depend on x.
questions.prompt_markup: f(x) = 3x + 5. Show that f grows by equal differences over equal intervals: find f(x + h) - f(x) in simplest form, and explain why it does not depend on x.
questions.required_method: Algebra showing f(x + h) - f(x) = 3(x + h) + 5 - (3x + 5) = 3h, and the statement that 3h depends only on the interval length h.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the simplified difference and the explanation.

questions.prompt: g(x) = 4 · 2^x. Show that g grows by equal factors over equal intervals: find g(x + h) ÷ g(x) in simplest form, and explain why it does not depend on x.
questions.prompt_markup: g(x) = 4 · 2^x. Show that g grows by equal factors over equal intervals: find g(x + h) ÷ g(x) in simplest form, and explain why it does not depend on x.
questions.required_method: Algebra showing 4 · 2^(x+h) ÷ (4 · 2^x) = 2^h, and the statement that 2^h depends only on h.
